name: Analysis-of-International-Tourist-Arrivals-in-Turkey-2008-2020
what_it_holds: Turkeytourists.xlsx and 'Tourists by Nationalities.xlsx', annual tourist arrivals to Turkey 2008-2020 (151 valid observations, 395,153,133 cumulative tourists cited), plus SPSS output files and a Word report. No explicit source citation in README but consistent with Turkish MoT/TUIK annual totals.
why_useful: Long annual back-history (2008-2020) for a MEA/Med gateway market relevant to EMEA demand comps; fills part of gap #7. Coarse (annual, no monthly granularity) so lower value than a monthly MoT series would be.
